metadata.methods_description: MEG was recorded with a CTF 275 system (340 channels including reference sensors, axial gradiometers, ECG and EOG) at the Montreal Neurological Institute. A single run of about 653 s was recorded at 12000 Hz with a 3000 Hz anti-aliasing filter and 3rd order gradient compensation. Binaural stimuli were delivered via intra-aural earphones and generated with the Matlab Psychophysics toolbox at an average presentation rate of 3 Hz. Head points and fiducials were digitized with a Polhemus Fastrak, and anatomy was acquired with 1.5T MRI and processed with FreeSurfer 5.3.
